visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with blonde-brown hair, wearing a red tank top and black patterned pants, walks down a narrow urban street with colorful buildings. She gestures excitedly toward her surroundings while looking at the camera. (2) She stops in front of a white sign for "Suthathip Massage" located under a building's overhang and points at it. (3) Inside the shop, she sits on a gray sofa in a brightly lit room with mirrors and wooden shelves, placing her phone into a small pink bag. (4) Staff members in tan uniforms are seen preparing towels for other customers sitting on nearby sofas. (5) Close-up shots show bare legs being covered with bright orange towels and later massaged with oil by a therapist's hands. (6) The woman lies back on the sofa, smiling broadly and giving a thumbs up, while a man in a black shirt and cap nearby appears to be sleeping under a brown blanket. (7) Finally, she walks out of the shop back onto the street, looking refreshed, laughing, and gesturing toward her legs before a final shot of a printed price list.
